_readme: Publish windows (UTC) for --publish-approved. Enforced only when BOARDWIRE_ENFORCE_PUBLISH_WINDOWS=true, which publish-bluesky.yml sets for scheduled runs (manual dispatch publishes immediately). GitHub fires scheduled workflows hours late (2.5-8h observed since late August 2026), so the workflow polls every 30 minutes and this file decides which of those runs may post: only inside a window, and only min_hours_between_posts after the previous post on the same platform. Breaking items ignore both rules. Windows assume US Eastern daylight time (EDT, UTC-4): weekday morning 9:00-12:00 ET, weekday midday 13:00-16:30 ET, Sunday evening 17:30-20:00 ET. Shift each window +1h in US winter (EST).
